messages.author: cf3eb0dff4b9d2d6
messages.subject: Updating Shiny packages with Rstudio-server
parts:
I've got my own server set up with Shiny-server and Rstudio-server. Both work fine, although I find that it is not possible to update the packages in the site-library of Shiny-server from within Rstudio-server. Any idea's?

> rstudio::versionInfo()
$version
[1] ‘0.97.551’

$mode
[1] "server"

messages.author: 9711d30301c32133
messages.subject: Re: Updating Shiny packages with Rstudio-server
parts:
I'm not sure I'm clear on the problem. The site library would be the same across the entire system for all users and software. Installing into that directory is just a matter of user privileges, so if you wanted to be able to install into that directory from RStudio Server, you would just need to make sure that the site library directory was writeable by your user.

But perhaps I'm misunderstanding...

Jeff
